analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($376.01) vs SMA5/20/50 ($397.28/$418.74/$424.65) — Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a bearish trend.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($395.62/$354.86) — Below SMA100, testing support above SMA200.
· 52-week position (59.7%) + Current price level shows downward pressure at a historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.4→34.5) — Entering oversold territory, suggesting potential for further decline.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -4.6204→-4.6204) — Bearish convergence continues, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $381.21) — Approaching the lower band, testing support.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($360.55) — Based on SMA200, a key support zone on further decline.
· Swing Resistance ($380.00) — Near 5-day low and Pivot S1, acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low maintained) — Sideways range, uncertain trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.53x) — Below average volume, indicating reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — Downward trend continues and RSI is oversold, requiring observation of support levels.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일한 수준을 유지하며 뚜렷한 하락 추세의 저점 이탈은 나타나지 않고 있다. 이는 횡보 구간에서의 약세 흐름으로 해석된다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day and 20-day lows are maintaining the same level, indicating no clear breakdown of the downtrend's bottom. This is interpreted as a bearish trend within a sideways range.
keyPointsEn: Continued downtrend with 5 consecutive negative days.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 19.2로 추세가 형성되지 않은 상태에서 RSI 과매도 진입 및 볼린저밴드 하단 접근은 되돌림 가능성을 시사하나, MACD 약세 수렴이 지속되어 하락 위험이 상존한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 19.2 indicates a lack of established trend; while RSI's oversold entry and proximity to the lower Bollinger Band suggest potential for a bounce, the persistent bearish MACD convergence poses a downside risk.
analysis.continuity: 4일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 기록 대비 RSI가 36.4에서 34.5로 하락하며 과매도 구간에 더 깊이 진입했고, MACD 약세 수렴이 지속되어 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: Maintaining a 'wait-and-see' stance for the 4th consecutive day. Compared to the previous record, RSI has fallen from 36.4 to 34.5, deepening into oversold territory, and the MACD bearish convergence persists, justifying the continued observation.
